raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.3.0"

package:
  name: gtsam
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/borglab/gtsam/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4539afcd47d336864deb8399e0a9a5c283a638f605892c942ec46f3541fd4fb0
  patches:
    - fix-metis-partition-label-order.patch
    - fix-link-threads.patch
    - fix-gtwrap-cmake-config-location.patch
    - if: win
      then:
        - fix-python-build-win.patch
        - fix-boost.patch

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ninja
    - cmake
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - pybind11
        - numpy
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - libboost-devel
    - eigen
    - eigen-abi-devel
    - geographiclib-cpp
    - metis
    - suitesparse
    - tbb
    - tbb-devel
    - pybind11
    - pyparsing
    - numpy
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - pyparsing
    - numpy
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("gtsam", upper_bound="x.x") }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - gtsam
      pip_check: false
  - requirements:
      run:
        - cmake-package-check
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - libboost-devel
        - eigen
        - tbb-devel
        - pybind11
    script:
      - cmake-package-check GTSAM gtwrap
  - files:
      recipe:
        - regression_test_25.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - if: build_platform == target_platform
          then: python
    script:
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then: python regression_test_25.py
      - if: not win
        then:
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgtsam${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/gtsam/base/types.h
      - if: win
        then:
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\gtsam\base\types.h exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\gtsam.lib exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\gtsam.dll exit 1

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/borglab/gtsam
  summary: GTSAM is a library of C++ classes that implement smoothing and mapping (SAM) in robotics and vision
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSE.BSD
    - gtsam/3rdparty/cephes/LICENSE.txt
  repository: https://github.com/borglab/gtsam
  documentation: https://gtsam.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - wolfv
    - ameysutavani
    - Tobias-Fischer
    - traversaro
